confirmed: Missing gamepad config selects enabled=true, deviceKey empty (automatic first mapped device); valid existing enabled=false is decoded unchanged.
Corrupt/unreadable gamepad config fails closed to disabled; GUI snapshots and Cancel do not persist; nested editors only change immutable parent drafts.
Both config stores use bounded no-follow reads, revision compare before writing and immediately before atomic replace; explicit save only.
Keyboard owner uses object identity and host authority suppliers; exact connection/alive/held or cabinet/range checks are retained by hosts. No new seat/ROM/network permission is created.

Keyboard pause/configure/toggle discard local held states; all assigned physical inputs must become neutral before rearming. Gamepad focus/device-generation/profile changes clear pad state; UI capture also resets neutral on changed DeviceId.
F7 settings route is available without a session while in focused in-world gameplay; it deliberately does not intercept an existing GUI/title screen. F8 route requires a current authorized owner.
Mixin is declared client-only and required; actual cached MC KeyboardHandler has keyPress(JIIII)V. Source injection is HEAD+cancellable. Actual Mixin transformer/application has not been executed.
320x240 and larger hub/device/mapping layouts are bounded; labels use vanilla Button rendering and fit+tooltip rather than scaled fonts.

findings.evidence: Original -108 row formula overlapped pager by one pixel at panel height 228/252. Latest source uses -112, matching the tested layout formula.
ARCADE native bits 0/1/8 are labelled button1/2/3 but current NUMPAD maps KP1/KP3/KP2 and WASD maps J/L/K. UI shorthand suggests sequential 1/2/3 and J/K/L.
findings.recommendation: Make ARCADE non-legacy preset explicitly sequential, or show exact mapping prominently; retain LEGACY unchanged.

findings.evidence: Config constructor checks presetKeys(LEGACY), not runtime MC custom/alternate/extras. Router gives settings/toggle priority, so a legacy A bound to F7/F8 or mute bound to a newly chosen settings key becomes unreachable.
findings.recommendation: Validate against effective legacy bindings and extras on save/attach, or explicitly warn/resolve priority without rewriting options.txt.

findings.evidence: New ownsController checks current listener identity but lacks actual Connection.isConnected, unlike the FC/cabinet/native keyboard authority. Brief same-reference closing-listener window may still be sampled.
findings.recommendation: Add isConnected to the new authority supplier only; no protocol change required.

recommended_final_probes: Actual final-JAR class origin checks for KeyboardRouting/KeyboardControlState/GamepadMixer/config stores, then execute existing behavior tests against those final classes without production recompilation.

Apply actual Sponge Mixin to the actual cached KeyboardHandler in an isolated JVM; inspect transformed bytecode to prove intercept+cancel-return precedes vanilla key click/chat/inventory logic. A source substring or annotation-only check is not this proof.

Exercise neutral rearming, owner replacement, old release isolation, config/device switch and F7/F8 authority through the actual pure routing/state classes. Preserve separate real-game and physical-device acceptance limits.
limits: No GUI screenshot, Minecraft window, physical controller/GLFW hotplug, Mixin transformed runtime or multiplayer gameplay executed.
Observed hotplug generations are based on polling; do not claim an actual hardware disconnect/reconnect test.
This report is a source review snapshot, not a release success gate; findings may be superseded by later owner fixes.
